text.en:
Paragraph 1 of Section 70 of the City Charter of Dipolog is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 70. The City Engineer - There shall be a City engineer who shall have charge of the Engineering and
Public Works Department. He shall be appointed by the Prime Minister upon recommendation of the Minister
of Public Highways who shall determine his qualification. He shall receive an annual compensation as fixed
by existing laws for City Engineers. The City Engineer shall have the following powers and duties:"
